craft_notes: Sthāyin: sonority-verse (dhāraṇā 18). Sanskrit: tantrādivādyaśabdeṣu dīrgheṣu kramasaṃsthiteḥ...para-vyoma-vapur → L4 keeps sound-domain then body-becomes-sky. Rows: row 3 (mind→sky-body). Close: body (vapur — the lyric promise: ear becomes sky). Rejected: 'veena' specific — killed: stringed-etc kept; 'concentration' — killed: undivided-mind kept (the mode, not the effort).

lines: Stringed instruments' long tones, ordered resonance:
undivided mind at limit — supreme-sky body.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tantryādivādyaśabdeṣu dīrgheṣu kramasaṃsthiteḥ | ananyacetāḥ pratyante paravyomavapur bhavet

reads_against.argmap: What sounds seat the undivided mind? → In the long tone of ordered sound, undivided mind seats the supreme-sky-body.
c1_essence: Long tone, undivided mind: supreme-sky body at limit.
